A kept prototype inserts scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_held_nodes on sys.path and exec_module()s its measure.py at line 23; that whole support directory's measure.py, batch.py, preflight.py, provenance.py and render.py were deleted while cpu.sh, gates.py and job.sh survived, so the prototype raises ModuleNotFoundError at import and the done-when's no-file-names-it clause is unmet.

A kept markdown file names deleted drivers (benchmarks/analytic_cost_floor.py:175 and benchmarks/polygon_route_cost.py:188, eight hits in all) with no revision stamp, so the done-when's 'no file at the head names it' clause fails for documentation even though no code breaks.

The batch table misstates three batches' removed lines: recorded 29926/29946/29685 for batches 4/5/6 against the commits' actual 29931/29959/29691, so the running totals are off by up to 24 lines (final 184989 is correct), which is a record-accuracy defect under done-when clause 3.
